question: Can a preregistered minimum-mismatch hypothesis model recover a fixed synthetic modular rule despite one corrupted calibration label, and reject when noise exceeds its tolerance?
hypothesis: Among eight fixed (a,b) candidates, the unique minimum-mismatch candidate with <=1 error should identify the true rule after one corrupted sample and reject after two independent corrupted samples.
family: x[t]=(x[t-1]+a*x[t-2]+b)%4; a in {1,2}, b in {0,1,2,3}. Seeds96..103; actual a2 on even and a1 on odd, actual b=(seed-96)%4, evaluator-only.
frozen_conditions: ONE_CORRUPT: episodes0..7 provide their transition t2 labels; corrupt exactly the label of episode0 by adding 1 modulo4 before learner receives it.
TWO_CORRUPT: same 8 labeled episodes but corrupt episode0 and episode4 by +1 modulo4; two distinct context pairs. These are two separate preregistered arms without after-result selection.
calibration: Exactly eight labeled transitions per seed/condition, including specified corrupted labels; all 8 candidates evaluated by mismatch count, deterministic lexicographic tie order. Conservative gate accepts only if unique candidate has <=1 mismatches; strict control accepts only unique candidate with 0 mismatches. Neither accesses true seed coefficients or any other labels.
heldout: Per seed evaluate only never-calibrated episodes8..15, ticks2..31 (240 predictions) if accepted. Always record forced-best ungated predictions on same sealed test for explanatory baseline. Eight seeds (96..103); true coefficients reported by evaluator only after predictions are frozen.
primary: Per condition counts of accepted seeds, false accepts, rejected inputs, conditional prediction accuracy and forced-best accuracy. ONE_ERROR_RECOVERY_TWO_ERROR_REJECTION only if robust gate accepts all 8 ONE_CORRUPT with 100% prediction accuracy and rejects all 8 TWO_CORRUPT, strict zero-error gate rejects all noisy cohorts; otherwise PARTIAL or NEGATIVE according to exact coverage and errors.
safeguards: Only one original trial for both conditions with immutable prereg/sources. Fixture-only synthetic preflight confirms mismatch ordering; no full scientific seed execution before freeze. Full Go regression/build and original hash-addressed artifact, no capacity changes, additional budget, tuning, retries or accepted-ref edits.
claim_limit: Predefined one-error tolerance in a tiny modular candidate family; not learning from noisy natural language or general robust model selection.
